name: bep_finance_medallion

activities.name: receive_bronze
activities.rule: Retain raw bytes, checksum, source id and ingestion time; never overwrite original evidence

activities.name: extract
activities.engine: Python notebook or document extraction service
activities.rule: CSV/XLSX adapter; PDF text extraction; scanned images -> OCR adapter -> review queue

activities.name: review_pdf
activities.rule: Pause PDF-derived records until accounting reviewer approves mapped fields and totals

activities.name: validate_silver
activities.rule: Wait for review_pdf for PDF-derived inputs; validate schema, branch, currency, dates, duplicates and totals; quarantine entire invalid batch

activities.name: publish_gold
activities.engine: Delta transactions per table + versioned publish manifest
activities.rule: Enforce unique business keys; revision scoped to source_id; publish one complete snapshot only

activities.name: refresh_semantic_model
activities.engine: Power BI model operation to configure
activities.rule: Only after all snapshot tables reconcile and publication succeeds

retry_policy.transient_network_or_throttling: Configure bounded retries and increasing delays after inspecting service errors
retry_policy.data_validation_or_missing_approval: Do not retry automatically; route to review

operations: run id and source checksum on every stage
row counts and VND totals at boundaries
persist failed stage and error reason
replay from retained bronze with pinned code/config version
alert on failures and stale approved snapshot
single publisher lock or lease per dataset
local_coverage: backend.pipeline.runner executes local Bronze/Silver/SQL Gold; template notebook imports approved Gold snapshot into Fabric. Full native cloud orchestration is not implemented.
